verdict.rationale: The only source-code evidence is Drata's endpoint agent repo on GitHub, which includes local build instructions, so that one component's source can be read. Nothing shows the core compliance platform's source is public, and the pack never names the agent repo's license, so the "open license" part is unverified. Missing for 10: public source for the core Drata platform, an explicitly documented open-source license, and independent corroboration of openness.
